## Comparability Caveat

The two figures most readily available for FY2023 are **not** on the same basis, so a direct comparison to FY2024 would be misleading.

- 3M's FY2023 10-K reported total revenue of **$32,681 million** [DOC-1], which included the Health Care business.
- On April 1, 2024, 3M spun off its Health Care business as Solventum Corporation (pro rata distribution of 80.1% of shares, structured as a tax-free spin-off), and "the historical results of Solventum are reported in 3M's consolidated financial statements as discontinued operations for all periods presented" [DOC-3].
- Accordingly, in the FY2024 10-K, FY2023 revenue was **recast to $24,610 million** on a continuing-operations basis, versus FY2024 revenue of **$24,575 million** [DOC-2].

Comparing FY2024 ($24,575M) against the *as-originally-reported* FY2023 ($32,681M) would imply a ~24.8% decline, but that is an artifact of the Solventum spin-off, not underlying performance.

## Like-for-Like Calculation (continuing operations)

| Item | FY2024 | FY2023 (recast) |
|---|---|---|
| Total revenue | $24,575M [DOC-2] | $24,610M [DOC-2] |

Change = $24,575M − $24,610M = **−$35 million**
Growth = −$35M ÷ $24,610M = **−0.14%**

On a comparable continuing-operations basis, 3M's revenue was essentially flat, declining approximately 0.1% year over year.

ANSWER: Approximately −0.1% (−$35 million, from $24,610M to $24,575M on a comparable continuing-operations basis; the ~−24.8% decline versus the originally reported FY2023 revenue of $32,681M reflects the Solventum spin-off, not comparable performance)
